item.title: Rare diseases are an overlooked dimension in climate–health adaptation
item.content:encoded:
Nature Climate Change, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02770-2

A resilient society must prepare not only for common harms but also for uncommon vulnerabilities, such as rare disease where the consequences leave no room for failure. Ensuring that people with rare diseases have reliable access to essential care is crucial for fairness and safety in a changing climate.
